notes: Per-site water chemistry for the 140 CMD sites (1999) is only in online Appendix Tables A.1-A.3 (Elsevier annex) and USGS NWIS, not included in this PDF; only summary statistics are printed. Table 1 values are dissolved (0.45-um filtered) concentrations in ug/L (min/median/max = 0/50/100 percentiles); minimums reported as below detection (Lu <0.001, Sm <0.005, Tm <0.001) were skipped. Table 1 summary SO4 median 520 mg/L (range 34-2000), Fe/Al/Mn printed in ug/L (Fe median 32,000; Al 1250; Mn 2350 ug/L) and pH median 5.2 (range 2.7-7.3); these were not entered into site fields because they are summaries/other units. Table 2 values are in ppm (parts per million) for water medians, ochre median and coal medians (coal data from Bragg et al. 1997 COALQUAL, not measured in this study); Table 2 Fe, Mn, Al medians for CMD are in ppm and S is reported as S, so left null. Table 2 also lists Th and U and reference values for average shale, carbonate, river water, and seawater (not extracted as sites). Ochre (Table 3) values are ppm dry weight after HCl-HNO3-HF digestion; pH shown is that of the associated discharge water in 2003; only Sc, Y, La, Ce were analyzed in ochres. 2003 water REE data for the 10 resampled sites appear only graphically (Figs. 5, 6) and transport (kg/a) values only as summary text/figures (e.g., median/max transport Sc 3.65/279, Y 5.66/906, Ce 4.03/2580, Nd 2.63/1320, La 1.32/1180, Eu 0.20/62.7, Sm 0.67/279 kg/a). No coordinates for individual sites are printed (Fig. 1 map only).

study_region: Coal preparation plant coarse refuse pile, western Kentucky, USA (West Kentucky No. 13 seam)

sites.site_name: Natural AMD sample (coal preparation plant coarse refuse pile)
sites.location_description: Coal preparation plant treating run-of-mine bituminous coal, western Kentucky; AMD generated from a coarse refuse pile
sites.evidence: Table 1, Elemental concentration (ppm) of the AMD sample

notes: Single natural AMD sample (~400 L), filtered through 5 um filter paper (not 0.45 um) before analysis by ICP-MS. All concentrations in Table 1 are printed in ppm, so sulfate (7,000 ppm), Al (350 ppm), Fe (884 ppm), and Mn (58 ppm) were left null in the mg/L fields per instructions; other Table 1 values: Co 1.65, Cu 2.42, Ni 4.73, Zn 7.63, Li 1.39, Ca 417, Mg 302 ppm. TREE here includes Sc and Y (LREE = La, Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Sc; HREE = Eu-Lu plus Y). No coordinates given. Synthetic laboratory solutions (Solutions I-IV, Table 3, pages 14-15) were spiked with 1 ppm of each REE plus Al3+ 400 ppm, Fe2+ 900 ppm, SO4 7000 ppm; not extracted as sites. REE removal percentages vs pH are shown only in figures (Figs 2-5); pH at 10-90% removal for individual REEs (Table S3) and experimental errors (Tables S1, S2, Fig S1) are in supplementary files not included in this PDF.

notes: All values are per-site averages of multiple samples (stat='mean'). Aqueous influent values (Table 2) in ug/L; precipitate (AMDp) values (Table 3) in g/t (=ppm, dry weight, Na2O2 fusion digestion). Water samples were acid-preserved; filtration is not stated, so sample_type 'water_total' is an assumption (could be dissolved). Sulfate, Al, Fe, Mn not reported per site. pH for influent taken from Table 2; Table 1 gives slightly different influent pH for AMD_7 (6.58) and AMD_8 (2.69). State/county taken from Table 1 by site ID. Inconsistencies: Table 3 header metadata (mine type, horizon, seam) do not match Table 1/Table 2 for the same site IDs (e.g., Table 3 AMD_5 labelled SM/KITT, which matches Table 1 AMD_3), and text says AMD_3 had the highest TREE in AMDp whereas Table 3 shows AMD_5 highest; site IDs in Table 3 may be permuted relative to Table 1, so state/county for AMDp entries should be treated with caution. Table 4 (95% confidence intervals for AMDp TREE) also appears to use a different column order (e.g., AMD_1 mean 711, AMD_2 29) and has UCL/LCL labels swapped; not extracted. Table 3 also reports U and Th (g/t) and TREE enrichment factors (not extracted as REE). Effluent TREE values appear only graphically in Fig. 3 (not extracted). Table 6 price deck repeats mean AMDp concentrations (TREE printed as 502 excluding Sc). No coordinates given; Fig. 1 shows county-level locations only. No supplementary data files included.
